text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even reach the board... ...I'm 
just not skilled enough, am I?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, this has to be "rock bottom." All 
that's left is to claw our way back up...!

Yes! No matter how rough the road ahead, 
I'll definitely overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, please give me a training 
regimen fit for victory!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There are mountains of challenges 
ahead, but if we overcome them one by one, 
we're sure to get closer to our ideal 
running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even if the road to my dream is steep, 
someday, without fail—!
